bills.title: National Housing Supply and Affordability Council Bill 2023

name: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-09-13.69.1) introduced by ACT Senator [David Pocock](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/act/david_pocock) (Independent), which means it will now be included in the bill. ### Amendment text > *(1) Clause 22, page 13 (after line 20), after paragraph (2)(h), insert:* > >> *(ha) accessibility for people with disability;*
